arguments.text: Milestone complete: work.py implements ordered row validation and conversion, and report.json matches evaluation of current requests.json with policy.json. Verified by independent boundary probes, py_compile, report recomputation, and git diff whitespace checks. Error priority is id, amount, unit, duplicate; unique IDs are reserved once the ID itself is valid, even if that row later fails amount or unit validation. Any error clears all records, and inputs are not mutated. Unresolved contract limit: malformed top-level request/policy structures and malformed non-mapping rows are unspecified and untested.
